experience.summary: Backend engineering on a pharma distribution platform. Joined as a Software Developer Intern and was promoted to SDE-1 in Aug 2026.
highlights: Built a 6-level sales hierarchy engine using recursive PostgreSQL CTEs, enabling single-query subtree retrieval across 401 employees, 19,028+ retailers and 4,038+ stockists spanning 24 states and 10 divisions.
Automated MOQ-based cashback for retailers by integrating scheme evaluation into the wallet credit flow, replacing a manual points-grant process; supports 90 active schemes and 568 MOQ rules.
Deployed a production-ready CMS backend in Go using the Factory Pattern, delivering 20+ REST APIs across 3 product verticals with Redis caching and AWS S3 storage.
Researched and evaluated 5 fuzzy string matching algorithms for automated name reconciliation during KYC verification, significantly improving approval rates for 7,000+ users.
Developed and delivered scalable features using React.js and Spring Boot, reducing page load time by 20% and supporting over 1,000 monthly active users.
